summary: Our project brings the forgotten stories of NASA discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars to life for young space enthusiasts . Since the 1960s , dozens of historic landers , rovers , and scientific instruments have been left behind after completing their missions . Through engaging accessible storytelling  our solution introduces school-age learners to where these machines are located , what scintific discoveries they made , and why their missions still matter today.  By turning technical space data into an interactive educational experience , we inspire the next generation of explorers  to appreciate the silent pioneers that paved the way for modern space exploration .
details:
What It Is: A simple slide presentation explaining NASA discarded equipment left on the Mars after completing its mission .

Purpose: To help students and young space enthusiasts easily understand what this equipment did and why it still matters for space exploration .

Tools Used : Official NASA mission information and Canva for creating the slide .
